WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    telescref,
    AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as overall_average
  FROM telescope_averages
)
SELECT 
  ta.telescref,
  ta.avg_modindex,
  ta.avg_modindex - oa.overall_average as exceeds_by,
  ta.avg_modindex / oa.overall_average as ratio
FROM telescope_averages ta
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE ta.avg_modindex > oa.overall_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
